comparison.objective: Lift a scrap sheet away while leaving four cut parts on the laser bed; candidate finishes four inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-edge bimanual pinch and level sheet extraction versus narrow mandrel alignment, impact delivery, and loose-fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Sheet removed to scrap bin while all cut parts remain on the bed versus four tangs fractured and deposited in a tray with inserts undisturbed.
comparison.reason: Selective sheet separation by level lifting is not controlled impact fracture, despite both requiring protection of retained parts. No separate spec versions were provided.
